property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any newOwner address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) makes c.owner() equal to the provided newOwner; the mutant that assigns tx.origin instead can set owner() to tx.origin instead of the supplied newOwner for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so transferOwnership sets owner = tx.origin instead of the provided newOwner.
